name: atlas-stage-runner
description: Deterministically stages approved Atlas Change Sets without placing payloads in model context.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Stage requires a trusted Atlas workspace.

languageModelTools.name: atlas_stageApprovedManifest
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Stages one digest-approved Atlas Metadata or Model Change Set from its local Stage request. Use only after local validation and user acknowledgement. Returns a bounded receipt and never returns payload records.

manifestPath.description: Absolute path returned by the Atlas prepare-stage-request helper.

expectedDigest.description: Exact local Change Set digest acknowledged by the user.

recoverOnly.description: Read-only recovery of an uncertain Stage: verify saved intended hashes against the governed draft and fingerprint. Never replay writes.

atlas.stageRunner.profile.description: Production requires Microsoft authentication. Local permits only loopback. Azure Local Test is an explicit temporary no-auth profile.

atlas.stageRunner.localUrl.description: Local MCP URL. Only loopback HTTP URLs ending in /mcp are accepted.
